summary: I collected the executed EPC Contract at the signing, checked it for initialling and annex completeness, and issued the Executive Summary and Key Terms for the project team. I set out the contractual notice calendar for the first 60 days and wrote to the Client's commercial manager to align on bonds, insurances, NTP and the kick-off. I also asked Finance-facing and engineering colleagues for the inputs I need for the bond and insurance submissions.

documents.title: EPC Contract — Executive Summary and Key Terms

sections.heading: 1. Purpose and Status of this Summary
paragraphs: This document summarises the key commercial and contractual terms of the EPC Contract for the HELIOS 100 MW Solar PV + BESS Power Plant (HEL001), executed on 2026-12-01 (Day 0) between Qizilqum Solar Energy JSC (QSE, the Employer) and Helios EPC LLC (HEP, the Contractor). It is prepared by the Contracts & Commercial Manager for the HEP project team and is a convenience summary only. In any conflict the executed Contract documents prevail, in the order of precedence stated in the Particular Conditions.

The executed set (Contract Agreement, Particular Conditions, General Conditions based on FIDIC Silver Book 2017, Employer's Requirements and Schedules) was collected at the signing ceremony. A page-by-page check of initialling and annex completeness has been carried out; any item noted as 'to be verified against executed copy' below must be confirmed from the controlled copy held by the Document Controller, Nilufar Yusupova, before it is relied upon for a notice or a payment.

rows: Khalid Al-Mansoori, Client Project Manager; Omar Hassan, Client Commercial & Contracts Manager
Rajan Iyer, Project Director; Thomas Becker, Contracts & Commercial Manager
Ulugbek Mirzaev, Head of Grid Connections, Navoi Region
Navoi Regional Administration & State Construction Inspectorate (GOV)
Shavkat Bobojonov, Deputy Head, Construction Supervision

sections.heading: 3. Scope, Price and Time
paragraphs: The Contract is a lump-sum turnkey EPC contract for the design, procurement, construction, testing and commissioning of a 100 MWac / 128 MWp solar PV plant (four blocks PV1-PV4, single-axis trackers, 620 Wp modules), a 50 MW / 100 MWh BESS, the 33/220 kV plant substation and a 220 kV overhead line of approximately 9 km to the nearest grid substation, at the Qizilqum Solar Site, Navoi Region.

The Contract Price is USD 95,000,000 lump sum. Time for Completion is 18 months from the Commencement Date, with Provisional Acceptance (PAC) targeted for 2028-05-31. Site working days are Monday to Saturday.

rows: Commencement of the Time for Completion

sections.heading: 4. Delay Liquidated Damages
paragraphs: Delay damages accrue at 0.5% of the Contract Price per week of delay in achieving Provisional Acceptance, capped at 10% of the Contract Price. On the stated price this equals USD 475,000 per week and a maximum of USD 9,500,000. The cap is expressed in the Contract as the Contractor's sole remedy for delay (to be verified against executed copy, including whether partial-week delay is pro-rated). Performance-related damages, if any, are set out in the Employer's Requirements and are to be confirmed by the Engineering Manager, Elena Petrova, and tracked separately.
Any extension of time claim that reduces exposure to delay damages must be notified within the time bars described in Section 8; late notice is likely to forfeit entitlement.

sections.heading: 5. Payment Terms
paragraphs: Payment is by an advance, milestone-based interim payments and a retention mechanism, certified through the Interim Payment Certificate process. Submission dates, supporting documents and the milestone definitions are those in the Schedule of Payments (to be verified against executed copy) and will be mirrored in the payment milestone register in folder 8/01.

rows: 10% of Contract Price, against an Advance Payment Guarantee (APG); recovered pro rata from interim payments
Per Schedule of Payments, certified by OWE and paid by QSE
5% of each certified amount, held by Employer, released against retention release guarantee or at PAC / end of defects period as stated in Particular Conditions

sections.heading: 6. Bonds and Insurances
paragraphs: The Contractor must furnish the Advance Payment Guarantee and the Performance Security from a bank acceptable to the Employer, in the form annexed to the Contract. The APG is a condition precedent to the advance payment (M03, 2027-01-05); the Performance Security is due within the period stated in the Contract (FIDIC Silver Book 2017 Sub-Clause 4.2 provides 28 days from the Contract Agreement, i.e. 2026-12-29; the executed Particular Conditions must be checked for any amended period and amount).

Insurances under Clause 19 (Contractor's All Risks / construction, third-party liability, and any marine cargo and workers' compensation required by the Employer's Requirements and Uzbek law) must be in place on or before the Commencement Date, and evidence delivered to the Employer. Procurement of cover and the bonds register will be managed by Contracts; the bonds register is held in folder 2/05 and the insurance file in 2/04.

sections.heading: 7. Key Amendments to FIDIC Silver Book 2017
paragraphs: The Particular Conditions amend the Silver Book 2017 on the following points. Each has direct operational consequences and the project team should work to them. Clause numbers are the FIDIC base clauses and the Particular Conditions numbering should be confirmed on the controlled copy.
bullets: Unforeseeable ground conditions (base Sub-Clause 4.12): the Silver Book allocates ground risk to the Contractor. The amended text is understood to grant relief only for conditions that could not reasonably have been foreseen from the geotechnical baseline in the Employer's Requirements (sandy loam over gypsum-cemented layers). Construction Manager Sanjay Mehta and the civil subcontractor must record any adverse ground encountered from the first piling campaign (M08, 2027-04-12) with dated photos and notices.

Grid connection interface: delay or failure by UzGridCo to provide the connection, energisation permit or back-feed by 2028-02-15 is treated as an Employer risk to the extent outside the Contractor's control; the Contractor must meet its own interface obligations and notify promptly.
Change in Law (Sub-Clause 13.6): adjustment of price and time for changes in Uzbek legislation after the Base Date, including customs, tax and permitting regimes. Notice is time-barred.

Force Majeure (Clause 18): standard FIDIC list, with notice required within 14 days of awareness. Extended weather events beyond normal site conditions must be separately assessed for Exceptional Events.

Employer's Requirements precedence: ER prevail over the Contractor's proposals where the Contract documents conflict, with the Contractor responsible for checking ER for errors under Sub-Clause 5.1; discovered ambiguities must be raised promptly via technical query.

sections.heading: 8. Contractual Notice and Submission Deadlines — First 60 Days
paragraphs: The following calendar is the working list for the first 60 days from Day 0. Time bars in FIDIC Silver Book 2017 run from awareness of the event or circumstance; the Contracts team must be informed the same day of any event likely to give rise to a claim, so that the 28-day notice period under Sub-Clause 20.2.1 is never missed. All contractual notices are issued by the Contracts & Commercial Manager on the Project Director's authority, through the Document Controller, in numbered letters.

sections.heading: 9. Immediate Contracts Actions and Open Points
paragraphs: Contracts will issue the insurance and bank guarantee instructions this week, provided the project accounts function confirms the guarantee facility headroom. Until then, the Performance Security percentage and the exact form wording remain open points and are shown as to-be-verified in this summary. A one-page clause finder for the project team will follow once the controlled copy is indexed.

letters.subject: HEL001 EPC Contract — Confirmation of Executed Documents and Pre-Commencement Contractual Deliverables
body_paragraphs: Dear Mr Hassan, Thank you and your colleagues for the signing ceremony today, 2026-12-01. We confirm that Helios EPC LLC has received its executed set of the EPC Contract (Agreement, Particular Conditions, Employer's Requirements and Schedules) and request that you confirm the Employer's set is complete and initialled as ours is, so that both parties hold identical controlled copies.

For planning purposes, we note the following pre-commencement items: (a) the Kick-off Meeting on 2026-12-03; (b) delivery of the Contractor's insurance evidence before the Notice to Proceed; (c) the Advance Payment Guarantee and Performance Security, which we will submit in the annexed form; and (d) the Notice to Proceed on 2026-12-15. Please let us have the name of the issuing bank you will accept and any comments on the draft bond forms by 2026-12-08.

Please also confirm the names of the Employer's authorised persons for notices, and the Employer's Representative's address for service, so that all notices are issued correctly from the first day. Yours sincerely, Thomas Becker, Contracts & Commercial Manager, Helios EPC LLC.

emails.subject: HEL001 EPC Contract executed — key terms summary and notice discipline
emails.body: Colleagues, the EPC Contract was signed today. The Executive Summary and Key Terms is now in the Contracts folder (2/01). Please read Sections 7 and 8 in particular. Rule for everyone: any event that may delay the works, change scope or cost money must be reported to me the same day, in writing, with date, location and photos. The claim notice window is 28 days from awareness and a late notice can cost us the entitlement. I will issue all contractual notices; please do not send contractual statements to QSE or OWE without clearing them with me. Thomas
